title: Work From Home Policy
content:
SAMPLE DATA - replace with the ComplyKaro sync.

Eligibility: Employees who have completed probation may work from home up to two days per week with their manager's approval.

How to request: Agree WFH days with your manager and mark them in your Outlook calendar. Recurring arrangements must be recorded in Zoho People.

Expectations: Be reachable on Teams during core hours (10:00-16:00 IST) and attend in-person meetings when requested.

title: Leave Policy
content:
SAMPLE DATA - replace with the ComplyKaro sync.

Annual leave: Full-time employees accrue 18 days of earned leave per year. Up to 10 unused days carry forward.

Sick leave: 8 days per year. A medical certificate is required for absences longer than 2 consecutive days.

Applying: Apply for leave in Zoho People at least 5 working days in advance for planned leave.

title: Travel and Reimbursement Policy
content:
SAMPLE DATA - replace with the ComplyKaro sync.

Approval: Business travel requires manager approval before booking.

Claims: Submit reimbursement claims with receipts within 30 days of travel. Claims are paid in the next payroll cycle.

Limits: Economy class for flights under 6 hours. Hotel limits vary by city tier.

title: Code of Conduct
content:

Respect: Treat colleagues, customers and partners with respect. Harassment and discrimination are not tolerated.

Conflicts of interest: Declare any outside employment or financial interest that could conflict with your role.

Reporting: Raise concerns with your manager, HR, or the confidential ethics line.

title: Acceptable Use of IT Systems
content:

Devices: Only company-managed devices may access customer data.

Passwords: Use multi-factor authentication for all company accounts. Never share credentials.

Software: Install software only from the company portal. Report lost devices to IT within 24 hours.
